instruction_text:
calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: This news feels like a short play in three acts. Act 1 was 20%. Act 2 brought a surprise. Act 3 was an unexpected move in oil prices. The curtain rose on July 13. At 10:16 a.m., Trump posted about a U.S. plan. The United States would seek a 20% charge on all cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The aim was to recover the cost of U.S. efforts to keep the Strait safe. But 20% was not a finished system. The post did not say who would pay. It did not say how the money would be collected. It did not say what law would support it. For the moment, only a large number stood at center stage. The number stayed at center stage for about a day. Then the story took a sharp turn.
